# f5ads_certificate (Resource)

Manages an F5 ADS certificate.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `public_certs` (String) Base64 encoded public certificates CA bundle or leaf certificate associated with the private key.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Unique name for the certificate. Changing this value forces a new resource to be created.
- `name_prefix` (String) Creates a unique name beginning with the specified prefix. Conflicts with `name`.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) Base64 encoded private key associated with the certificate.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the certificate, assigned by F5 ADS.
- `not_after` (String) Not after date of the certificate.
- `not_before` (String) Not before date of the certificate.
- `status` (String) Current status of the certificate.
- `subject` (String) Subject of the certificate.
- `type` (String) Type of the certificate.
